title: Early-Route Premium — Mobile In-Home Collection Visit Rate Card
content:
**Rate card, Mobile In-Home Collection Visit — Specimen Collection Appointments.** A home trip on an early route carries an early-route premium, an amount added to the trip:

- a visit starting **before 07:30 on a Saturday or Sunday** carries an early-route premium of **15.00**;
- a visit starting **before 07:30 on a weekday** carries an early-route premium of **8.00**;
- a visit starting **at 07:30 or later** carries none.

The start is the appointment start time on the visit record (start of the arrival window, local time of the site), and the day is the day of the week of the appointment date.

| Start time | Weekday (Monday to Friday) | Saturday or Sunday |
|---|---|---|
| Before 07:30 | 8.00 | 15.00 |
| 07:30 or later | None | None |

### Boundary readings (hypothetical start times)

| Appointment | Start | Premium |
|---|---|---|
| A Tuesday | 07:00 | 8.00 |
| A Tuesday | 07:30 | None — 07:30 is not before 07:30 |
| A Saturday | 07:00 | 15.00 |
| A Sunday | 08:00 | None |
